name: CI: Jest
description: GitHub Actions workflow that calls rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows ci-test-js.yml. Runs Jest with optional cache. Calls `@v1` by default.

inputs.description: Tag or ref of rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows to call.
Node.js version. Leave empty to use the project's .nvmrc, which the shared workflow reads.
Cache Jest transform/result data across runs. Pass 'true' or 'false'.
